list.name: item_id
list.label: Item
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, '' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT item_id AS __text, item_id AS __value FROM items ORDER BY __text

list.name: item_type
list.label: Item Type
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, '' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT type AS __text, type AS __value FROM items ORDER BY __text

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS item_count FROM items WHERE (${item_type:sqlstring} = '' OR type = ${item_type:sqlstring})

panels.title: Item Detail ($item_id, $item_type)
panels.description: Filtered by the Item and Item Type pickers above - shows every item when both are "All". avg_rating/rating_count/completion_rate/watch_count/average_age/pct_male/pct_female/pct_other/pct_unknown/viewer_count are NULL for an item missing the underlying activity (no ratings, no watches). pct_male/pct_female/pct_other/pct_unknown always sum to 1.0 when present (item-viewer-demographics, distinct viewers - see its README).

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.item_id, i.type, i.title, i.release_year, i.genre_primary, i.genre_secondary, i.content_rating, i.imdb_score, i.is_netflix_original, i.catalog_status, r.avg_rating, r.rating_count, c.completion_rate, c.watch_count, d.average_age, d.pct_male, d.pct_female, d.pct_other, d.pct_unknown, d.viewer_count FROM items i LEFT JOIN item_rating_avg r ON r.item_id = i.item_id LEFT JOIN item_completion_rate c ON c.item_id = i.item_id LEFT JOIN item_viewer_demographics d ON d.item_id = i.item_id WHERE (${item_id:sqlstring} = '' OR i.item_id = ${item_id:sqlstring}) AND (${item_type:sqlstring} = '' OR i.type = ${item_type:sqlstring}) ORDER BY (substring(i.item_id from 2))::int LIMIT 200

panels.title: Avg Completion Rate ($item_type)
panels.description: Average, across matching items, of each item's own completion_rate (fraction of that item's watches that reached the 85% watched_seconds/duration_seconds threshold). Computed by the item-completion-rate job over reporting-db.watch_events, all-time - only counts items with at least one watch. Per-item completion_rate/watch_count live on Item Detail above, not a separate table - it duplicated Item Detail with no extra filtering that view didn't already offer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((avg(c.completion_rate) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS avg_completion_pct FROM item_completion_rate c JOIN items i ON i.item_id = c.item_id WHERE (${item_type:sqlstring} = '' OR i.type = ${item_type:sqlstring})

panels.title: Avg Rating ($item_type)
panels.description: Average, across matching items, of each item's own avg_rating (item-rating-avg, all-time mean of every rating that item has received - the item-side mirror of the Users dashboard's Average Rating panel). Only counts items with at least one rating. Per-item avg_rating/rating_count live on Item Detail above, not a separate table.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(r.avg_rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating FROM item_rating_avg r JOIN items i ON i.item_id = r.item_id WHERE (${item_type:sqlstring} = '' OR i.type = ${item_type:sqlstring})
